author: Benjamin Geoffroy Dit Belhumeur
title: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series
content: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series. Belhumeur Books is looking for an illustrator for the first book in a new children's picture book series, and we want it to be the start of a long partnership, not a one-off gig. Pay: $3,000 flat for book one, in four $750 milestones. To apply: Email belhumeur.books@gmail.com with your portfolio link, 3–5 samples showing the same characters across multiple scenes and angles plus sequential pages, a sentence or two about yourself, your availability, and confirmation your work is original and human-made (no generative AI). Timeline: Hire by November 1, 2026.

author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES. Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST.

author: Sealious Seal
title: LF people who can draw Pokemon
content: LF people who can draw Pokemon. You don’t have to be a Pokemon-centered artist or anything, I just want artists who are willing to draw Pokemon or know how more specifically, Garchomp and Lucario. I usually prefer more anime-esque styles and the OC is cutesy and elegant, but given the Pokemon, I can’t be picky this time around when it comes to the style. Place your rates and samples in the comments, NO DMS! MOP: GCash. This is the OC (credit to Miki Fleur) and she will be wearing more fashionable clothes.
